title: Approval window displays truncated amount while full precision is signed
root_cause: approval UI reuses balance formatter with magnitude-dependent decimals (>=10 -> 2dp, roundDown) for the amount under confirmation; serializer signs the original <=8-decimal string at full precision
discovery_method: end-to-end dApp send flow trace + D1 spec-vs-code diff against the project's own in-repo audit doctrine; verbatim-code node harness on x.99999999 corpus
payload: zcash_sendTransaction {to, amount:"12.99999999"} -> approval shows 12.99, tx signs 1299999999 zats
takeaway: grep amount formatters inside approval components; diff display vs serialization precision; check fix-commit branch topology before claiming release impact (merge-base --is-ancestor gate)

title: CRX-verbatim harness: extract extension URL-matching code and execute offline to diff two implementations of one rule
root_cause: extension implements page-site matching twice (strict component-compare vs regex substring .test()); looser side accepts URLs merely containing pattern text
discovery_method: unzip published CRX, extract Okta.Url.matches + parseUri verbatim, run 46-row boundary corpus in node with lodash-lite shim
payload: matches('https://app.com/',true) HITS https://evil.com/?u=https://app.com/ ; 1-arg strict path rejects all cross-origin shapes
takeaway: two matchers in one binary = ready-made differential; mechanism-proven != impact-proven — kill-pass found the credential path was strict-mode-only and password-free

title: Aura request envelope travels in headers; guest guard kills the unauth family in 2 probes
root_cause: aura.context/aura.pageURI/aura.token are HTTP headers, message= is the only body param; community-level guest rejection returns HTTP 200 + aura:invalidSession + exceptionMessage
discovery_method: read the site's own aura_prod.js envelope builder, then 2 manual POSTs (getConfigData, getAppBootstrapData)
payload: POST /help/s/sfsites/aura with header envelope -> {"exceptionMessage":"Guest user access is not allowed"}
takeaway: 2 target-returned probes kill the whole unauth-aura family; then move to authed controllers (executeGraphQL class, Mandiant Jan-2026)

title: Okta fixes point-instances, not classes: vendor fix-history sweep is the highest-yield intel query
root_cause: ScaleFT/ASA/PAM URL/argument injection fixed 4x (2022x2, 2023, 2026 leading-hyphen) without class sweep; agent hygiene debt 5 incidents/4 years across AD/LDAP/Verify/RADIUS/OPP; Oct-2024 unknown-UA policy skip, Nov-2024 DelAuth bcrypt-truncation cache replay, Apr-2024 FastPass missing-Origin-as-safe
discovery_method: vendor advisory RSS + sec.okta.com primary fetches instead of CVE dump
payload: sibling-hunt matrix: unclassified request conditions x policy evaluation; cache-key composition boundaries; missing-field-safe-defaults in device trust; scaleft:// handler argv shapes
takeaway: for Okta-family targets, sweep the FIX HISTORY classes, not the CVE list — every fix was point-targeted

title: Header-gate fingerprinting on sec-fetch/UA-gated CDN bundles

discovery_method: curl header-matrix vs bundle fetch
payload: curl with/without sec-fetch-dest/mode/site headers
takeaway: edge-side validation means app-level injection classes may be dead before the app; fingerprint the wall first

title: Client-set identity headers on public-product APIs are not authz flaws

discovery_method: bundle contract extraction + identity rotation probes
payload: rotate user-id UUID header
takeaway: check whether the API is a sold public product before writing the quota-bypass report

takeaway: x-amz-version-id in responses ≠ bucket enumerable via CDN

root_cause: Validator returns true when Uri.parse(url).getHost()==null; scheme URLs have null host; sink WebView has setJavaScriptEnabled(true) + addJavascriptInterface.
discovery_method: jadx decompile; grep getHost()==null near deeplink validators; traced dispatcher->PendingDeeplinkRepository->WebView->bridge
payload: bolt://action/openBrowser?url=javascript%3A...
takeaway: Severity = bridge inventory; whitelist must reject non-http(s) schemes explicitly

takeaway: probe live state machine BEFORE ranking; pause-gated code = conditional findings

title: Audit-resolved config-only fixes stay live-vulnerable until governance applies them on chain
root_cause: fix commit changes deploy/config JSONs and declares the live shape invalid ('setOracle guards userDeviation > burnRatioDeviation; two mainnet collaterals violate it... Governance must apply the same change on chain') but chain state keeps the old config; resolution marked Resolved in the published report regardless
discovery_method: decode live oracleConfig bytes via cast call getOracle() on all collaterals; compare against the fix commit's declared invalid shape; grep fix-commit messages for 'must apply ... on chain'
payload: cast call $DIA "getOracle(address)(uint8,uint8,bytes,bytes,bytes)" $COLL --rpc-url $RPC; decode hyperparameters field[0]/field[1]
takeaway: treat every config-only audit resolution as UNVERIFIED until the live config decodes to the fixed shape; the fix commit message is the oracle for what the vulnerable config looks like

title: Accrue-before-act turns an overflow state into a freeze that includes the emergency pause
root_cause: pause()/setRate()/setMaxRate() all run _accrue() (Taylor terms in rate^exp) before acting; once the (rate,exp) threshold makes accrual revert, even the emergency pause reverts — recovery only via UUPS upgrade
discovery_method: vault battery foundry test: drive rate to maxRate + idle exp, then attempt deposit/pause/views (T08); verified recovery-function ordering by reading the act functions' first lines
payload: foundry T08: vm.deal rate → warp exp → expectRevert Panic(0x11) on deposit AND pause()
takeaway: when auditing any lazy-accrual vault, diff the recovery functions' first statements: any accrue-before-act means the halt mechanism shares the accounting's failure mode

title: One-sided peer unset: sends pass, receives revert — user funds stuck with owner-only recovery
root_cause: OFT peer maps are inbound-only (OAppReceiver.sol:64); send side never checks the dst peer. base oapp peers(30338)=0x0 while sonic has base configured → sonic→base burns tokens+fees then lzReceive reverts on peer mismatch
discovery_method: diff the public peers(uint32) getter across every connected oapp PAIR (both directions); never trust repo config — deployed storage layout drifted
payload: cast call $OAPP "peers(uint32)(bytes32)" $EID --rpc-url $RPC for each eid on each side
takeaway: peer-config audits must read the getter on BOTH endpoints of every pair; a one-sided unset is a silent fund-loss path, not a deliberate block

title: Byte-compare live runtime vs fresh local build per target before claiming repo-faithfulness
root_cause: deployed Savings/TokenP impls differ byte-level from HEAD builds (selector-dispatch region) while GenericRebalancer is byte-faithful — repo analysis is only as good as the per-target drift check
